lines.speaker: ROSHI
lines.text: Nobody gets strong on the exciting days. They get strong on the dull Tuesdays when nothing is watching.

then.text: A muscle doesn't grow while you lift. It grows while you sleep. The lifting just asks it to.

then.text: A tired body learns nothing. A tired mind learns worse.

lines.speaker: ROSHI
lines.text: Here is the rule I gave my first students. Work hard, eat well, rest well, and keep doing it.

lines.speaker: ROSHI
lines.text: I had a teacher once, you know. I wasn't born an old master. I was born a baby, like everyone.

lines.text: The best teaching is sneaky. That's why I give you small habits instead of speeches. You're getting stronger behind your own back.
